Cash flow is king. You bleed too much doing this you die. Call graphic designers and say you are shopping for graphic artist and ask for quick estimates for the types of projects you would like to do. Be specific that you have not shopped for these types of services for and you want ball park to see if you can afford to hire them in your budget. You will get quick answers what people are willing to pick up their pencils for. Look at the posters on your main street bulletin boards and see who is designing them if they are putting the firms name on the bottom corner in small print. Are you already involved in any social groups that require designs? Does the local pub have open mic night? Regular shows on saturday night? See if you can get into recurring clients. Is there bingo night or perogy night at the church. See if you can get in on any of that for any price to build a portfolio and a style. About the nitty gritty with the print shop. Go to your local print shop and talk shop. He doesn't want to waste materials or time so taking the time to plan your prints will only benefit both of you. Also the print shop if they get slammed at certain times of year might be willing to contract you out temporarily. What you are responsible for is agreed in the terms on your signed purchase order you receive. If they want digital copies of it all make sure it is outlined. If someone else is outsourcing work to you they may want all digital files un flattened in the native file format so they can make tweaks easily like date changes. If you are doing logos. Client will want high res for printing and different formats for the web team. If you score a client for logo letter head and decals and other stationary and you will be submitting many designs or a length of time. It is appropriate to phase your project in your proposal. Phase 1 preliminary 5 options. Phase 2. Polished options of 1 max 2 designs with max 3 iterations. Phase 3 delivery of all files and final product. Each phase should have a separate price breakdown. You might get clients who want prelims and decide to go with someone else. You want to make sure you get paid for that work you did do. Hope this helps.
